title: SpinCastML an Open Decision-Making Application for Inverse Design of Electrospinning Manufacturing: A Machine Learning, Optimal Sampling and Inverse Monte Carlo Approach
abstract: arXiv:2602.09120v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electrospinning is a powerful technique for producing micro to nanoscale fibers with application specific architectures. Small variations in solution or operating conditions can shift the jet regime, generating non Gaussian fiber diameter distributions. Despite substantial progress, no existing framework enables inverse design toward desired fiber outcomes while integrating polymer solvent chemical constraints or predicting full distributions. SpinCastML is an open source, distribution aware, chemically informed machine learning and Inverse Monte Carlo (IMC) software for inverse electrospinning design. Built on a rigorously curated dataset of 68,480 fiber diameters from 1,778 datasets across 16 polymers, SpinCastML integrates three structured sampling methods, a suite of 11 high-performance learners, and chemistry aware constraints to predict not only mean diameter but the entire distribution. translated_title: SpinCastML：一种用于静电纺丝制造逆向设计的开放决策应用——机器学习、最优采样与逆蒙特卡洛方法
translated_abstract: 静电纺丝是一种强大的技术，可生产具有应用特定架构的微米至纳米级纤维。溶液或操作条件的微小变化可改变射流状态，产生非高斯纤维直径分布。尽管取得了显著进展，但现有框架无法在整合聚合物溶剂化学约束或预测完整分布的同时，实现针对目标纤维结果的逆向设计。SpinCastML是一款开源的、分布感知的、化学信息化的机器学习和逆蒙特卡洛（IMC）软件，用于静电纺丝逆向设计。基于严格整理的来自16种聚合物、1778个数据集的68480个纤维直径数据集，SpinCastML集成了三种结构化采样方法、一套11种高性能学习器以及化学感知约束，不仅预测平均直径，还预测整个分布。Cubist模型结合聚合物平衡的Sob（此处可能截断，但完整摘要中应继续，不过根据提供的文本，我将其完整翻译）。
tldr: SpinCastML是首个开源、分布感知且化学约束的静电纺丝逆向设计工具，能预测完整纤维直径分布而非仅均值，并通过最优采样和逆蒙特卡洛实现目标导向的工艺优化。
en_tdlr: SpinCastML is the first open-source, distribution-aware, and chemistry-constrained inverse design tool for electrospinning that predicts the full fiber diameter distribution rather than just the mean, enabling target-oriented process optimization via optimal sampling and inverse Monte Carlo.
